question: Which ATT&CK techniques does CAPEC-639 (Probe System Files) map to, and what mitigations apply to those techniques?

answer.headline: Gathered 6 record(s) from 2 source(s); 5 cross-source correlation(s) on shared identifiers.
answer.narrative: CAPEC-639 (Probe System Files) maps to ATT&CK techniques T1552.001, T1552.003, T1552.004, T1552.006, and T1039. Mitigations for T1552.001 include Audit (M1047), Restrict File and Directory Permissions (M1022), Password Policies (M1027), and User Training (M1017). T1552.003 is mitigated by Operating System Configuration (M1028), T1552.004 by Encrypt Sensitive Information (M1041), Audit (M1047), Restrict File and Directory Permissions (M1022), and Password Policies (M1027), and T1552.006 by Update Software (M1051), Active Directory Configuration (M1015), and Audit (M1047). T1039 has no listed mitigations.

records.label: AttackPattern
records.description: An adversary obtains unauthorized information due to improperly protected files. If an application stores sensitive information in a file that is not protected by proper access control, then an adversary can access the file and search for sensitive information.
